title: Free part of a split frequency set
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $J$ be a subset of the coordinates $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. For any subset $S$ of $J$ and any subset $T$ of its complement, the part inside $J$ of the union of $S$ and $T$ is $S$.
